# Xiao

> Xiao is Zen Browser (a Firefox-based browser) with ad and tracker blocking built into the browser itself, about 90 hardened privacy and speed settings, optional Tor tabs and an optional local search (Xiao Search, a SearXNG instance). It runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. Free software under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

Xiao comes two ways: a kit that makes Xiao's own copy of an installed Zen Browser, with Xiao's code loaded through Firefox's AutoConfig and a separate profile (shell or PowerShell installer), and builds from Zen's source with a rename and overlay (set up, not yet compiled). There is no extension. Blocking uses Ghostery's open-source engine with EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock Origin lists, prebuilt and refreshed daily. Tor tabs are a Firefox container routed through a local Tor client; they fail closed when Tor is not running, and they hide the user's IP address but do not give Tor Browser's anonymity.

- [What Xiao changes](https://gitguy268.github.io/xiao/privacy/): every browser setting Xiao sets, the connections Xiao makes, and how memory was measured
- [Release notes](https://gitguy268.github.io/xiao/release-notes/): changes per version (RSS: https://gitguy268.github.io/xiao/feed.xml)
- [About](https://gitguy268.github.io/xiao/about/): credits and licence
